settings.title: Big Loader Capability. Compact Loader Footprint.

settings.editor: Mammoth compact wheel loaders bring full-size lift performance to job sites where conventional loaders won’t fit. Powered by Cummins Tier 4 Final diesel engines, the same trusted powerplant found across global construction fleets, every compact wheel loader in the Mammoth lineup delivers reliable, emission-compliant output from the first cold start of a Canadian winter through the hottest August pour. ±40° articulation lets you turn within your own length, perfect for tight stockpiles, indoor recycling, dense urban builds, and snow-clearing in confined lots. Three compact wheel loaders for sale in Canada: the WL4500 (74 HP, 4,500 lb ROC), the TL5500 Telescopic (199 in. dump height), and the WL7500 flagship (121 HP, 7,400 lb ROC).
“Articulation that tight changes what jobs we can bid. We're getting into yards a full-size loader can't even back into.”
Three models, entry to flagship, covering 74 HP through 121 HP.
The compact workhorse. 74 HP Cummins, 4,500 lb ROC, ±40° articulation for tight sites.
Telescopic boom for high-stack loading. 199 in. dump height clears most truck sides.
Flagship power. 121 HP, 7,400 lb ROC, air-ride seat, auto-lube. Built for full days.
Match the loader to your operating capacity, dump-height, and budget.

settings.title: What Is a Telescopic Wheel Loader?

settings.editor: The TL5500 Telescopic compact wheel loader extends its boom hydraulically to deliver 199 inches of dump height, enough to clear the side of any 30-yard truck, fill silos, or load second-floor scaffolding. You get articulated compact wheel loader manoeuvrability and reach height a conventional loader physically can’t match. Same Cummins QSF engine, same ±40° articulation, same 5-year Mammoth Shield Warranty. For Canadian operators who load high-sided trucks, service recycling yards, or stack material in tight footprints, the TL5500 is the only compact wheel loader in its class with telescopic reach. Ships with 405/70R20 winter tires, skid-steer hydraulic quick-attach, and AC/Heat cab, ready for year-round Canadian operation.
Industry-leading coverage on every wheel loader: powertrain, hydraulics, and structural components. No fine print, no hidden gotchas.

Compact wheel loader financing tailored to construction, snow-removal, and recycling operators across Canada. Apply online. Most decisions in under 60 minutes. Not sure what you qualify for? ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What's the difference between the WL4500, TL5500, and WL7500?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: The WL4500 is the compact workhorse: 74 HP Cummins, 4,500 lb ROC, 120 in. dump height. The TL5500 adds a telescopic boom for 199 in. dump height, ideal for high-side trucks and silos. The WL7500 is the flagship: 121 HP Cummins, 7,400 lb ROC, 2.0 m³ bucket, air-ride seat, and auto-lube standard.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What makes a compact wheel loader different from a skid steer?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Wheel loaders use articulated steering (±40° for Mammoth) rather than skid-steering, which means dramatically less ground disturbance, better fuel economy, smoother ride at travel speed, and longer tire life. They're the right choice for finished surfaces, snow removal, and longer travel distances.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Are Mammoth wheel loaders compatible with skid steer attachments?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes, every Mammoth wheel loader ships with a skid-steer compatible quick-coupler, so you can use the same buckets, forks, sweepers, snow blowers, and grapples across your fleet.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How does the TL5500's telescopic boom work?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: The TL5500's boom extends hydraulically while lifting, delivering up to 199 in. of dump height versus ~120 in. on a conventional loader of the same class. That extra reach clears side-dump trucks, loads silos, and stacks material higher in tight footprints.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What warranty comes with a Mammoth wheel loader?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Every wheel loader ships with the Mammoth Shield Warranty: 5 years or 3,000 hours (whichever comes first) covering powertrain, hydraulic system, and structural components. Among the longest warranties in the compact-loader segment.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What is the best compact wheel loader for snow removal in Canada?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: For most Canadian snow-removal operations, the WL4500 compact wheel loader is the entry point: 74 HP Cummins, ±40° articulation, and 405/70R20 winter tires standard. Contractors clearing large commercial lots or loading snow trucks consistently opt for the WL7500: 121 HP, 7,400 lb ROC, and 17.5R25 snow tires handle the heaviest pushes. All three Mammoth compact wheel loaders are configured for Canadian winters out of the box.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How much does a compact wheel loader cost in Canada?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Mammoth compact wheel loaders for sale in Canada start at $68,999 CAD for the WL4500, $73,999 CAD for the TL5500 Telescopic, and $139,999 CAD for the WL7500 flagship. Financing is available from 1.99% to 0% APR with flexible terms up to 72 months, making a compact wheel loader accessible without a full cash outlay. Prices include the Mammoth Shield 5-Year / 3,000-Hour Warranty and winter tires standard.
